column1: # The (gate-name -> anchor-number) binding for the CM-COVENANT-114-<N>-PROPAGATION
# gate family. ONE row per gate. The engine
# (lib/covenant_propagation_engine.sh) is the single code copy; each
# gate NAME (required so the §11.4.227(A) gate ledger's structural
# `grep --include='*.sh'` instrument can see a real executable gate site) and
# looks its anchor up HERE. No role-specific value is duplicated in code.
# Lines beginning with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
